item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 16 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 16 #VISPRSD
Issued at 11:11 PM 03 October 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Leyte(Burauen, Javier, Mahaplag, SanIsidro, Tabango), #SouthernLeyte(Sogod, Bontoc, TomasOppus, Malitbog and Macrohon) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Leyte(OrmocCity, Albuera, CityOfBaybay, Matalom, Bato, Hilongos, Hindang, Inopacan), #SouthernLeyte(CityOfMaasin), #Samar(Daram and Zumarraga) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Watch #VISPRSD
Issued at 10:00 PM 03 October 2026

Thunderstorm is MORE LIKELY to develop over #OccidentalMindoro, #Palawan, #Iloilo, #Guimaras, #Antique, #Capiz, #Aklan, #NegrosOccidental, #NegrosOriental, #Cebu, #Bohol, #Siquijor, #Leyte, #SouthernLeyte, #Biliran, #EasternSamar and #Samar within 12 hours.

All are advised to continue monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 15 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 15 #VISPRSD
Issued at 09:31 PM 03 October 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Bohol(BienUnido, Buenavista, Trinidad, Ubay) and #NegrosOccidental(Cauayan) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Bohol(Getafe, Talibon), #Leyte(Isabel), #Antique(TobiasFornier and Hamtic) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
